name: What steps should I take if my restaurant experiences a sewage backup?

mainEntity.name: What steps should I take if my restaurant experiences a sewage backup?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your restaurant experiences a sewage backup, the first critical step is to immediately close off the affected area to prevent contamination and protect staff and customers. Then, cease all food preparation and turn off water supply to the affected fixtures if safe to do so. Contact a professional commercial plumbing service specializing in backups right away. Do not attempt to clear it yourself, as sewage contains hazardous materials. Our team can quickly diagnose the cause and implement a safe, effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: If a sewage backup occurs, close the affected area, stop food prep, turn off water, and immediately call a professional commercial plumber to handle the hazardous situation safely.
